key_provisions_or_claims: AI raises privacy and data security risks through unauthorized data collection and sharing.
AI can generate inaccurate or biased information and reinforce existing biases, including Western-centric news.
Responsibility for AI errors (developers, users, or AI) remains unclear.
Chatbots and virtual assistants may manipulate human choices.
Autonomous weapon systems without human control may cause war crimes and civilian casualties.
annotation.summary_en: Popular-science article on Bilim Genç (TÜBİTAK) by Assoc. Prof. Bahar Kayıhan outlining AI ethical problems: privacy violations, misinformation and bias, Western-centric AI news, manipulation via chatbots, unclear responsibility, and autonomous weapons lacking human control. It is descriptive and proposes no specific governance instrument.
annotation.title_clean: Yapay Zekâ ve Etik Sorunlar: İnsanlık, Teknolojinin Kontrolünü Kaybediyor Mu?
annotation.title_en: AI and Ethical Problems: Is Humanity Losing Control of Technology?
